1.80 War God Slight Variant Game Introduction

1.80 War God Slight Variant is a side-scrolling action platformer set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Take control of a heavily armed mechanical dragon, tear through hordes of zombies and mutated bugs across desolate ruins, rescue survivors, and embark on an adrenaline-fueled fight for survival.

Core Gameplay: Mech Rampage, Side-Scrolling Combat

  • Control the Mechanical Dragon: Pilot a mechanical dragon equipped with heavy firepower, moving freely across desert battlefields and mowing down enemies with machine guns, flamethrowers, missiles, and more. Smooth movement and satisfying hit feedback make every battle a thrilling display of destruction.

  • Multi-Skill Combo Combat: The dragon comes with exclusive skills such as area-of-effect fireballs, piercing spikes, and tracking projectiles. Unlock more powerful abilities as you progress through levels, and combine them to pull off flashy combos against zombies, swarms of mutated bugs, and other foes.

  • Level Objective Challenges: Each level features kill goals and time limits. You must eliminate a set number of enemies within the time frame while protecting survivors, unlocking more levels and storylines, and taking on higher-difficulty wastelands.

Featured Systems: Post-Apocalyptic Wasteland & Mech Progression

  • Desolate Wasteland Environments: Set against barren deserts and abandoned ruins, complete with cacti, wrecked cars, and other post-apocalyptic elements. The atmosphere is both bleak and tense, capturing the unique feel of a world on the brink of collapse.

  • Dragon Upgrades & Progression: Use rewards and collected resources from levels to upgrade your mechanical dragon’s attack power, health, and skill strength. Unlock more powerful weapon attachments to craft your ultimate doomsday weapon, and take on even stronger foes with ease.

  • Survivor Rescue Gameplay: Encounter trapped survivors in levels; rescuing them grants bonus rewards and advances the story. Experience glimmers of humanity in the apocalypse, giving your journey more purpose.

Game Experience

In 1.80 War God Slight Variant, you will become the guardian of the wasteland, charging through gunfire aboard your steel dragon and tearing through enemy lines with overwhelming firepower. Satisfying combat, diverse skill combinations, and tense level challenges deliver an immersive side-scrolling action experience. Whether mowing down hordes with machine guns or unleashing full-screen barrages with all skills active, you’ll feel the raw power of apocalyptic mechs at every turn. Join now, pilot your mechanical dragon, and save the wasteland!

WHAT IS INOCULATE

INOCULATE is a cinematic, 2.5D horror game, set in a collapsing Arctic research station currently under lockdown due to the appearance of an unknown entity that has started attacking and consuming facility personnel. You are put into the shoes of a Communication Officer, who was lucky enough to survive the initial chaos, but are now stuck inside the facility with that creature, with only one clear goal in mind: Survive and Escape.

EXPLORE A COLLAPSING FACILITY

Make your way through a facility that was once filled with the noises of machinery and people talking, but is now silent, with the only sounds being the siren in the background and screams echoing throughout the facility. 

THE HORROR WITHIN

You are not alone in the facility. Something else is roaming the hallways and laboratories, hunting for survivors to consume and assimilate into itself, becoming bigger, stronger, and more dangerous. Encounter and escape from the creatures, their designs inspired by movies such as 'The Thing.'

YOU CAN'T FIGHT BACK

You are not a soldier. And even if you were, you would not win in a direct fight. Hide, sneak, and stay out of sight if you want to survive. In the scenario where you get spotted: Run.

Pulsewave

A geometric twin-stick arena shooter built on speed, precision, and decisions. No textures, no bloat — just pure neon and the line between you and your next shot.

Three modes, one arena

  • ARENA — Classic deathmatch. First to the kill cap wins. Brutal, fast, decisive.

  • CAPTURE THE PULSE — Hold the energy orb to bank points. Get hit, lose it, race back to the center. First to 30 takes the match.

  • PAINT WAR — Each kill paints the floor in your color. Whoever covers more territory when the timer ends wins the war.

Build your fighter

A 91-node skill tree across 5 archetype branches — Vanguard, Anchor, Sharpshooter, Phaser, Sustainer. Path-from-root allocation. Notable nodes that change how you play. One keystone you commit to. Respec costs SURGE — rebuild any time.

Free to play, fair to fight

Pulsewave is free to play. Cosmetics — auras and trails — are the only thing premium currency buys. No pay-to-win. Your hitbox never changes regardless of what you wear. Skill is the only unlock that matters.

Story Background

In a world struck by a plague, once infected, humans turn into monsters. Just as everything is plunged into despair, a legend emerges — the Still Train.

If you survive and manage to reach it, you will find hope for survival. It sounds unbelievable.

You will play as an adult woman named Luna Lexus. After a shooting incident, Luna loses her memory. When she opens her eyes again, she finds herself, as the last survivor of this world, aboard a mysterious train. What she must do next, with the help of the conductor Diqiu, is return to the world ravaged by monsters and plague — and recover her lost memories.

Character Introduction

  • Luna Lexus (Protagonist)

A classic upbeat protagonist you’d find in any typical story — so how come she ended up losing her memory? A bit clumsy, isn’t she…

She claims she wants to bring something fresh to the audience, but the protagonist doesn’t seem willing to reveal much else about herself. Looks like she’s aiming to keep an air of mystery.

---

  • Diqiu (Train Conductor)

A calm and reliable conductor, mostly expressionless — possibly a case of facial paralysis. It would probably be amusing if someone could get him to show another expression.

The type who prefers to act directly rather than talk or think things through. And his love for combat seems genuine.

Despite that hairstyle, his right eye isn’t blind — seems like he’s just making a fashion statement.

Controls

Use the arrow keys to move the character. Press ESC / X to open the menu. Press Space to investigate / interact with NPCs.

This game requires manual saving.

store_data.about_the_game:
This game was born from an image that has become a part of internet culture — a lone penguin leaving its colony and walking into the endless icy wastelands toward gigantic, almost unreachable mountain peaks. Online, this image is often seen as a symbol of nihilism, loneliness, or a meaningless journey toward death. But the game is built on a completely different interpretation of that story.

There will always be voices around you trying to pull you back: some out of fear, others out of envy, and others simply because they themselves stopped believing in something greater long ago.

But can you make it through all that pressure, refuse to let other people’s words become your own thoughts, and still keep moving forward — toward what you truly want?

But can you keep going even when dangers, mistakes, and moments lie ahead where the whole world seems to be convincing you to stop?

If the answer is yes — then go. Don’t give up. Find the strength within yourself to keep moving forward, even if the unknown awaits you, even if you are afraid. Only you are meant to live your life, not someone else.

The story becomes not a tale about death or nihilism, but a reflection on human life itself. About why people leave their «colonies», why they strive toward impossible peaks, and what exactly drives them to continue the journey, even when all that surrounds them is cold and emptiness.

store_data.about_the_game:
Renegades is a turn-based party card battler about five fugitives trying to cross a kingdom that has decided people like them should disappear.

The Kingdom of Valdris has outlawed unsanctioned magic. The old orders have bent, the roads have gone dark, and the people who once held the frontier together are being hunted. Your party did not set out to save the world. They defected, survived, and kept walking.

Choose three characters for each battle. Each has their own deck, hand, items, defenses, and role in the fight. Every turn, play cards drawn from the deck of your characters in combat, spend your actions carefully, then watch the round resolve: your party first, enemies second. Complete optional objectives to win rewards in the form of more power or better loot.

Key Features

  • Multi-character card tactics- Fight with 3 active characters from a roster of 5, each with an independent deck and tactical identity.

  • Deterministic turn resolution - Plan your round, play cards in any order, then weather the enemy response.

  • Distinct party roles - Hold the line with Hyperion, heal and break enemies with Solyn, set traps with Faide, mark and detonate with Luciana, and turn blood into power with Arinas.

  • A world map built around visible choices - Explore the Greenveil Forest, uncover Points of Interest, face roaming threats, and decide which roads are worth the risk.

  • Original music - that captures the spirit of battle and the Renegades world.

  • Narrative consequences with mechanical weight - Events, defeats, and hard choices can leave temporary emotion cards in your deck: Hope, Shame, Vengeance, Grief, and more.

  • Character growth through mastery - Invest in character-specific mastery lines to unlock new cards, passives, and stronger tactical identities.

  • Gear, consumables, and battle rewards - Shape your loadouts between fights and earn bonuses for clean victories, risky plays, and careful execution.

This is a game about tactics under pressure, trust earned slowly, and the small decisions people make when every road leads north.

store_data.about_the_game:
Colorland Friends is a gentle and engaging educational game designed to help young children learn and recognize colors through play.

The game is structured into three main levels, each consisting of three interactive stages, gradually building the child’s understanding of colors.

Across the experience, children are introduced to a total of ten essential colors:
- Level 1: Introduces 4 basic colors
- Level 2: Introduces 4 additional colors
- Level 3: Reinforces all 10 colors together

Stage 1 – Learning
In this stage, children are introduced to colors through friendly cartoon characters.
- Five different characters appear, all sharing the same color
- This repeats for each color in the level
- Then, each character is shown again in multiple colors
This helps children understand that color is a property that can change, while the object remains the same.

Stage 2 – Interaction
Children are encouraged to actively participate.
- A colored character appears on screen
- A palette of colors is displayed
- The child selects the matching color
This stage reinforces recognition through hands-on learning and repetition.

Stage 3 – Relaxation & Reward
After learning and testing, children enjoy a calm and rewarding moment.
- Milo, the friendly monkey host, appears in a short animation
- He walks through the environment, creating a relaxing transition
- At the end of the level, Milo reaches his home, giving a warm sense of comfort and completion

Core Experience
Colorland Friends combines learning, interaction, and relaxation to create a balanced experience that keeps children engaged while building confidence in color recognition.

Designed for children aged 3–6.

Learn Mahjong From an Interactable Videotape

At first, this is a fantasy arcade mahjong tutorial.

The tape teaches you how to read tiles, form hands, understand waits, watch discards, and win your first match against a computer opponent.

But after the lesson ends, the tape keeps going.

Real Mahjong, Now Roguelike

You'll quickly transfer your mahjong skills into the roguelike challenge. It is still based on real mahjong rules, but now you can build your tile set, find synergies, win more, and win big.

Build Around Real Mahjong Hands

Every run starts from the language of mahjong: suits, honors, sequences, triplets, pairs, waits, calls, and scoring patterns.

Then the roguelike layer starts bending the lesson.

Add more of the tiles you want. Remove tiles that slow you down. Strengthen certain suits, boost honor tiles, reward triplets, support pairs, or build toward rare patterns. A small change to your inventory can turn a normal hand into the start of something much bigger.

Rewind the Tape

When a round goes wrong, rewind the tape and try another take.

Maybe your opponent wins before you. Maybe your hand wins, but not by enough. Maybe you can already clear the round, but you saw a better hand hiding a few turns back.

Rewinding lets you return to an earlier point in the recording, use what you learned, and play the hand differently. It is not only a safety net. It is part of how you build bigger wins.

Find Synergies in the Static

Between matches, choose upgrades that change how your run develops.

  • Add or remove tiles from your set

  • Boost specific patterns

  • Pick Sticker items that reward your preferred style of play

  • Use arcade-style Command items to change the game

  • Discover powerful modchips to break the rules

A Tutorial With Something Underneath

The tape teaches you how to read tiles, form hands, understand waits, watch discards, and win your first match against a computer opponent.

But after the lesson ends, the tape keeps going.

Real Mahjong, Now Roguelike

You'll quickly transfer your mahjong skills into the roguelike challenge. It is still based on real mahjong rules, but now you can build your tile set, find synergies, win more, and win big.

Every run starts from the language of mahjong: suits, honors, sequences, triplets, pairs, waits, calls, and scoring patterns.

Then the roguelike layer starts bending the lesson.

Add more of the tiles you want. Remove tiles that slow you down. Strengthen certain suits, boost honor tiles, reward triplets, support pairs, or build toward rare patterns. A small change to your inventory can turn a normal hand into the start of something much bigger.

When a round goes wrong, rewind the tape and try another take.

Maybe your opponent wins before you. Maybe your hand wins, but not by enough. Maybe you can already clear the round, but you saw a better hand hiding a few turns back.

  • Discover powerful modchips to break the rules

This tape looks like a bright arcade mahjong tutorial, but the recording seems to have something underneath.

Keep playing.

Keep rewinding.

玩家将扮演青鸾国的公主，在临危受命成为女王后，肩负起发展壮大国家的重任，周旋于各方势力之间，最终开创属于自己的盛世。‌‌

游戏核心特色

‌1. 沉浸式剧情与角色互动‌

游戏中邂逅超过百位性格迥异的角色，包括身世神秘的侍从伽蓝、别扭单纯的相府公子长孙子安、温柔深情的竹马谢语花、算无遗策的军师洛飞卿以及强势霸道的敌国皇子赫连钰等。‌‌

每位角色都有专属剧情与情感线，玩家可通过互动深入了解其背景故事，建立深度羁绊。‌‌

游戏采用超高精度的国风立绘，构建了一个华丽梦幻的东方世界。‌‌

服饰系统支持多部位拆分，玩家可自由搭配上千种风格的华裳，并可通过挑战副本获取图纸，亲手制作喜爱的服饰，享受设计与换装的双重乐趣。‌‌

‌成长与权谋‌：玩家需从公主一步步成长为一代女帝，在宫廷与权谋斗争中做出决策，主宰自己的命运。‌‌

By day, this is a light-drinks bookstore.

By night, beneath the deep sea, we journey to the end of dreams.

Talk Insomnia is a visual novel that blends suspenseful weird tales with mixology. You play as Ming, a bookstore staff member who prepares drinks for guests during the day and delves into their stories at night. With the warmth of a single drink, you draw out the secrets buried deep in their hearts.

As for the phone legend entwined with every guest—is it the greed of those who make wishes, or a trap set by an imitator? Is it a natural curse, or the work of a corrupted heart? Who is the true culprit behind the legend?

Let us piece together the truth hidden beneath all the lies, in the space between dreams and reality.

Welcome to the deep sea of the subconscious. In dreams—no one can lie.

The Abyss Bookstore Legend Incident is about to begin.

The player takes on the role of Ming, a bookstore clerk, who guides guests into their subconscious dreams by mixing a special drink called "Abyss".

Within the dreams, collaborators possess special abilities — sensing emotions, detecting lies, forcing follow-up questions, rewinding and resetting, and more.

Players must gather clues during the day and solve mysteries in dreams at night, uncovering the truth through layer after layer of twists. Mixing drinks is not just a backdrop setting, but a core mechanic that runs throughout both the narrative and the gameplay.

The story revolves around a phone-based urban legend involving wishes and their costs, exploring the disconnect between greed, desire, and the sense of happiness.

Behind every guest lies a mysterious legend, and behind every legend lies the human heart.

"In the late-night phone booth, a voice asks you what wish you want to fulfill." The legend is not a natural disaster, but a man-made one. An imitator plays with people's hearts by exploiting the rules, and the true culprit is hiding among the guests.

As players connect the cases, they must also confront their own memories and the mystery of their identity, ultimately revealing the mastermind behind the legend.

About This Game

Deep Shift is an atmospheric underwater station simulation game that combines maintenance, repair, exploration, and the gradual restoration of a forgotten deep-sea facility.

You are transported to the station by trawler and lowered deep beneath the ocean surface in a diving bell. Far below the waves, a massive aging underwater facility waits in complete silence — damaged, partially flooded, without power in many areas, and barely operational.

You take over the shift of a former technician who already abandoned the station. At the beginning, only a small section of the facility is accessible. Your quarters, basic tools, a workbench, and an old diving suit become your starting point. From there, you slowly bring the station back to life piece by piece.

Repair damaged systems, restore power, water, oxygen, and pressure systems, seal leaks, remove corrosion, clean contaminated areas, and reopen sealed sections of the station. Many failures require more than simple repairs — heavily damaged components must be completely replaced.

Major maintenance work requires precise procedures: water or power systems must first be shut down, damaged pipe segments removed with a grinder, and new physical replacement parts transported, installed, and welded or secured into place.

As the facility is restored, new sections of the station become accessible, including flooded corridors, engineering sectors, maintenance shafts, and exterior underwater areas. Equipped with your diving suit, you venture into the dark depths of the ocean to perform external repairs and recover lost parts of the station.

Every repaired system visibly changes the station. Dark rooms come back to life, machinery powers up, lights return, and more sections of the facility become operational again.

Later in the game, companies and research teams begin using parts of the station for their own operations. New crews arrive in supply diving bells, establish work areas, and create new maintenance jobs, damage, dirt, and technical problems that require constant upkeep.

Features

  • Atmospheric underwater station setting

  • Repair, maintenance, and cleaning systems

  • Power, water, pressure, and oxygen management

  • Physical tools and interactive repairs

  • Replacement of damaged pipe segments and modules

  • Transport and installation of physical replacement parts

  • Flooded and unlockable station areas

  • EVA and underwater exterior sections

  • Dynamic maintenance and station tasks

  • Immersive first-person gameplay

  • Deep-sea atmosphere and environmental storytelling

  • Gradual restoration and expansion of the station

  • Companies, research teams, and new work areas in the midgame

  • Slow-paced, immersive, and relaxing gameplay experience

Beyond the station walls, the ocean waits in complete darkness. Deep beneath the surface, the future of the station depends on your work.

Умер? Начни заново. Мир изменится: появятся фразы, которых раньше не было, и варианты, мимо которых ты прошёл. Разное прохождение – разные пути. Каждая смерть оставляет след.

ВСЕМ НЕ УГОДИШЬ – И ЭТО НОРМАЛЬНО.

Дружина ждёт добычи. Народ – мира. Кочевники – твоей головы. Коротко – ДНК. Поднимаешь одних – другие тихо ненавидят. Живи с этим.

ТВОЙ ХАРАКТЕР – НЕ ПРОСТО ЦИФРЫ.

Смелость, Интеллект, Любопытство, Авторитет. Коротко – СИЛА. Они растут не в меню, а от твоих слов и поступков. Каждая прокачка открывает новые варианты. А есть и скрытые пути – с первого раза не заметишь.

Устал править и распутывать свою память? Сыграй в местную карточную игру. Но она откроется только самым любопытным.

ТАИНСТВЕННЫЕ ПРЕДМЕТЫ.

Попадаются странные камни. Что-то в них есть такое, что не объяснишь ни поверьями, ни случайностью. Может, ключ к тому, кто ты на самом деле.

ИНТЕРАКТИВНАЯ КАРТА.

Реки, города, вождества. Можно дипломатией. Можно войной. Решаешь только ты. Но история не дремлет – за ошибки она наказывает. Хотя и обмануть её можно.

И МНОГОЕ ДРУГОЕ...

store_data.about_the_game:
Command your party. Conquer the dungeon together.

Rally the Parties is a semi-real-time tactical RPG where time only flows while your active character is acting. You direct the battle through high-level orders, and your party members act autonomously based on their assigned policies. You can switch between characters at any time to take direct control of any role.
Melee, ranged, support, lockdown, flanking — seven character classes each bring unique combat techniques, and your tactical options shift dramatically depending on how you combine them. Orchestrating synergy between party members is the key to success.

Features

  • Semi-real-time combat: Time only advances while your character is acting — a distinctive system that lets you think carefully before committing to your next move.
  • Seven classes, seven roles: Swordfighter, Axe Warrior, Scout, Archer, Fire Mage, Water Mage, and Healer. Each has its own attack range and special abilities, and the way you mix them reshapes your strategy.
  • Lead through directives: Issue party-wide orders such as Attack, Defend, Rally, or Retreat. Your companions interpret your intent and act on their own judgment.
  • Recruit and expand: Talk to NPCs you encounter in the dungeon and build a party of up to eight. Different combinations open up entirely different approaches.
  • Multiple parties exploring at once: You're not the only group in the dungeon — several NPC parties roam and explore on their own. Sometimes you cooperate, sometimes you compete; their presence gives the adventure life and unpredictability.
  • Roguelike stakes: One defeat ends the run. Every attempt invites you to rethink your party, equipment, and tactics on the path to the Demon Lord at the deepest floor.

Screenshots

Origins

In my youth, I was struck by Ali Baba (Starcraft, 1985) — an RPG where you switched between multiple characters as you played — and was further captivated by the arcade game Gain Ground (Sega, 1988), which built its design around the strategic use of distinct characters with unique abilities. That sense of fascination has never faded.
In the years since, tactical RPGs and MMORPGs flourished, and games featuring parties of cooperating characters became commonplace. But none of them quite captured what I was looking for. The ideal game system remained a recurring daydream — never something that felt within reach to actually build.
Then came the recent rise of generative AI, which suddenly made it possible for an individual to produce a game at a quality previously requiring a full studio. Sensing that this might be the last opportunity to bring a long-held idea to life, I finally began development. Rally the Parties is the result.

Who this game is for / About Early Access

This game is made for players who:
  • Enjoy game systems built around strategically managing multiple characters
  • Are drawn to experimental games that step outside familiar genre conventions
  • Are looking for a gameplay experience they haven't had before
Rally the Parties launches in Early Access. The core combat system, party formation, dungeon exploration, and the full path to the Demon Lord battle are all in place — even now, the game offers a complete, self-contained experience. Ongoing balance refinement, additional content, and UI/UX improvements are planned. Please see the "About This Early Access Game" section below for details.

store_data.about_the_game:
A world held together by old oaths and older wounds.

IconicQuest is a pixel-art, top-down MMORPG built for people who remember when the genre respected your time. Real-time skill-based combat. A shared persistent world. Loot that means something. No pay-to-win, no auto-battle, no skip button. Built solo, in the open, by one developer.

Combat you have to actually play.

You swing, they swing back. Accuracy ratings, evasion, weapon velocity tiers, attack speed — every hit is calculated, every miss is yours to learn from. Different mob families have different patterns. You learn their patterns. You stop dying as much. That's the game working correctly.

Position matters. Buffs matter. Preparation matters.

A world with places that mean something.

Teon Town sits at the center of four roads. Each one leads somewhere specific — a wasteland where the creatures have started moving with purpose, a frozen north sealed by an inscription someone chiseled out, a half-buried fortress where a watcher named Gareth doesn't say much.

You find things by going places. Every landmark was put there for a reason the world has mostly forgotten. Some of those reasons are still waiting.

Gear that means something.

No junk drops. No rarity inflation. When a weapon drops, you remember it. Crafting requires a recipe scroll, the right materials, and the right station. Enchant your gear from +1 to +16 — succeed and it gets stronger and starts to glow, fail and you don't.

You'll use the same sword for a long time. That's not a flaw. That's the point.

Real multiplayer. Not singleplayer with online tacked on.

A shared persistent world. Party system. Player nameplates. Open-world grinding zones. Group dungeons. PvP. The kind of MMO where the people around you are people, not bots, and where going somewhere dangerous together is an agreement, not a matchmaking queue.

The promise.

  • No pay-to-win, ever. Cosmetics and convenience only. Power is earned in the world.

  • Real-time, skill-driven combat. No auto-play, no skip buttons.

  • Loot has weight. No junk drops, every item earns its slot, the economy is real.

  • A world worth exploring. Hand-placed, not procedural. Every road leads somewhere.

  • Built alone, in the open. By someone who has spent 22 years playing MMOs and decided the game they wanted didn't exist yet.

Early Access: what you'll find at launch.

  • Real-time combat with multiple mob families and distinct archetypes

  • Open-world exploration with hand-placed zones, towns, and dungeons

  • A starting class system with branching specializations

  • Station-based crafting (anvil, workbench, campfire) with recipe scrolls dropped from mobs

  • Gathering: mining, with herbalism, woodcutting, and fishing on the roadmap

  • Enchanting from +1 to +16 with visible glow tiers and risk of failure

  • Full party system with shared persistent world and player nameplates

  • PvP in designated open-world zones

  • Group dungeons including the Temple of Ice and Fire

  • Quest system with kill, collect, deliver, and dialogue objectives

  • Travel Master NPCs for fast travel between zones you've discovered on foot

Why Early Access.

IconicQuest is built by one developer. Early Access is how the world grows next: more zones, more dungeons, more classes, more depth — built with the people playing it, not in a vacuum. The roadmap is public. The Discord is where it happens first. If you want an MMO that respects your time and your wallet, this is where to start.

The Gavel Falls in Gallows & Gold

Sentence the guilty and spare the innocent—or do the opposite. Set in a grim medieval era, Gallows & Gold is a hand-etched judgment simulator where your verdicts carry the weight of life and death. Navigate corruption, law, and your own morality in a world crafted entirely in pen and ink.

The Gavel is Yours.

The King is fading, the treasury is dry, and the people are hungry. You have been appointed to the High Court of Anglia—not to find the truth, but to maintain the peace. In a kingdom where the "King’s Rot" consumes the crown and the Church demands its pound of flesh, justice is a luxury the realm can barely afford.

Key Features

The Weight of Judgment: Every morning, the doors creak open to reveal a new soul seeking mercy or a new villain deserving of the rope. You are the final arbiter. No decision is easy. Review evidence, listen to pleas, and weigh the testimonies of the desperate. Every sentence you scrawl reshapes the kingdom's future—affecting the economy, public order, and your own standing with the crown.

Based on Real History: Preside over trials inspired by actual medieval court records. From frantic farmers accusing their livestock of witchcraft to where pigs were prosecuted for murder, no two cases are the same. You will face the same bizarre dilemmas as judges of the Middle Ages.

Judge the absurd & The Grim: 

Analyse the Evidence: Sift through the Evidence Ledger to find the truth, or ignore it entirely if the bribe is high enough.

Declare the Sentence: One click decides it all. Whether you decide the convict is innocent or guilty, the question is do you let them free or at what length do you punish the guilty? You decide.

The Impossible Balance

Your bench is a scales of three weights: The Crown, The Church, and The Commoners.

 Rule for the King to keep your head, even if the laws grow more erratic.

 Rule for the Priest to keep the Church’s favour, or risk being branded a heretic yourself.

 Rule for the People to stop the city from burning, even if it leaves the royal coffers empty.

Beyond the Courtroom

When the candles low, the trial ends, but the game continues in your Private Chambers.

 Rewrite the Law: Use your Law Ledger to toggle the decrees of the land. Make the "Tax on Bastardy" a reality or mandate archery practice for every peasant.

 Reap the Rewards: Reinvest your gold into the Judicial Estate. Upgrade your execution equipment to ensure "efficiency," or build labour camps to turn convicts into currency.

 Medieval Moral Complexity: Navigate a world of deep political intrigue. Will you uphold the strict letter of the law, or will you accept "gold" to look the other way? In the medieval era, justice is rarely blind, and the truth is often a matter of perspective.

 The Kingdom: Every choice you make carries a compounding weight. Will your judgements lead the land to flourish in a golden era, or spark an immenent demise?

 Branching Narratives: Your verdicts have ripples. Sparing a thief might lead to a rebellion; hanging a saint might lead to a miracle. Witness the long-term consequences of your judgments across multiple playthroughs and endings.

The evidence is thin, the rope is thick, and the King is waiting. What is your verdict?

Blackout Protocol is a systems-driven sci-fi survival prototype where you must restore power, stabilise a damaged spacecraft, and bring critical ship systems back online before time runs out.

Restore the Ship

Start with minimal emergency power and bring the ship back online step by step. View the spacecraft from a top-down 3D view while interacting with ship devices, control panels, alerts, and camera feeds.

Use In-World Ship Interfaces

You are aboard a damaged vessel drifting towards danger. The ship is dark, unstable, and running on limited emergency power. Every active system matters. Lights, consoles, batteries, generators, and ship systems all affect the power state, so careless use can slow recovery or leave critical systems unavailable.

The ship is hand crafted with a mostly intuitive layout where players will need to explore and learn about the different devices and systems on board.

SINKING INTO THE VOID is a 2D side-scrolling hack-and-slash action game focused on intense battles against powerful enemies.

Players can equip up to three weapons at once and switch between them instantly to adapt to any situation.

Fast-paced combat combines movement, jumping, and dashing with melee attacks, ranged attacks, and abilities.

In addition to guarding enemy attacks, players can perform a precise “Just Guard (Parry)” by blocking at the exact right moment.

A successful parry can stun enemies, reflect projectiles, and completely turn the tide of battle.

Each stage features unique gimmicks and a wide variety of enemies, while boss stages offer even more challenging encounters.

The game also includes time attack elements, encouraging players to refine their routes, optimize their equipment, and push for faster clear times.

Equipment is divided into six slots: Right Hand, Left Hand, Head, Body, Arms, and Legs.

Items come in four rarity tiers: Normal, Rare, Epic, and Legend.

Equipment can also grant a wide range of special effects, such as:

  • Launching fireballs when attacking

  • Increasing damage as HP gets lower

  • Becoming invincible while jumping

By combining these effects, players can create their own unique combat style and build.

Carefully choosing randomly dropped equipment, refining builds, and constantly improving clear records are at the core of the experience.

SINKING INTO THE VOID is an action game designed to keep players saying, “Just one more run.”

  • 词组连输： 全面支持各类中文输入法的词组连续输入！无需逐个选定方格，输入完整词条即可自动填充，让解谜如行云流水。

  • 温情助攻： 遇到暂时无法攻克的生僻字？点击“提示”按钮即可揭晓。

  • 一键校对： 拿不准填得对不对？随时使用“检查”功能，系统将即时反馈正确性，助你精准破局。

store_data.about_the_game:
Idlemoor is a dark fantasy idle RPG set in a persistent online realm of ruined settlements, grim barrows, and slow-burning character growth.

Choose how your character survives: fight enemies, train combat styles, gather resources, craft gear, trade with other players, fight against other players in PvP, and climb the rankings. Progress continues while you are away, but active players can make sharper decisions, react to community events & random events, manage the market, and push deeper into the world.

Core Features

Persistent online progression
Your character keeps advancing over time through server-side saves and account-based progress.

Combat, training, gathering, and PvP battlegrounds
Fight players & creatures, improve combat stats, mine, woodcut, forage, skin animals, and build your character through multiple highly-connected complex gear & stat systems! 

Player economy
Buy, sell, and trade through a shared marketplace where player activity shapes item movement.  Each item is totally unique, and will never drop with identical stats.  Build your character with multiple in-depth skill systems, as well as several stat and gear systems that connect to form a complex meta-game of infinite potential choices!

Community features
Chat with other players, compete on rankings, engage in community events every day, and take part in a persistent realm instead of a purely local idle game.

Idle Pacing
Idlemoor is built for long-term progression: short check-ins, longer grinds, rare drops, and slow accumulation of power.
